categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes LevelDB wrapper and coins view architecture without altering general utilities or vendored libraries.
categories.rationale: Does not belong to utils. The database wrapper (`src/dbwrapper`) and coin storage logic are validation and storage infrastructure, not generic utility primitives.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Matches the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies UTXO database and coins view error handling in `src/coins` and `src/dbwrapper`.
categories.rationale: Prevents database corruption from being masked as non-existent coin entries or causing unhandled exceptions. As the description notes, deserialization failures in `CDBWrapper::Read()` previously returned `false` while read errors threw exceptions, potentially treating corrupted inputs as missing; centralizing fatal aborts in `CDBWrapper` eliminates the fragile `CCoinsViewErrorCatcher` abstraction.
